questions.question: How do you create a counter with Angular signals?
questions.questionMarathi: Angular signals वापरून counter कसा तयार कराल?
questions.answer: Create a writable signal with an initial value and update it through set() or update(). Reading the signal in a template tracks the value and updates the view when it changes.
questions.answerMarathi: प्रारंभिक value देऊन writable signal तयार करा आणि set() किंवा update() ने ती बदला. Template मध्ये signal वाचल्यावर Angular बदल track करतो आणि value बदलल्यास view update करतो.
questions.codeExplanation: The signal stores the count, and update() derives the next value from the previous value.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: Signal मध्ये count साठवला जातो आणि update() मागील value वरून पुढची value तयार करतो.

questions.question: How can you render a list with Angular's @for block?
questions.questionMarathi: Angular च्या @for block ने list कशी दाखवाल?
questions.answer: Use @for to repeat a template for each item and track each item by a stable unique key. Tracking helps Angular reuse DOM nodes efficiently when the collection changes.
questions.answerMarathi: प्रत्येक item साठी template पुन्हा दाखवण्यासाठी @for वापरा आणि स्थिर unique key ने items track करा. Collection बदलल्यावर tracking मुळे Angular DOM nodes कार्यक्षमतेने पुन्हा वापरतो.
questions.codeExplanation: track task.id gives each row a stable identity; @empty displays content when the collection is empty.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: track task.id प्रत्येक row ला स्थिर ओळख देतो; collection रिकामी असल्यास @empty मजकूर दाखवतो.

questions.question: How do you validate a required field with Angular reactive forms?
questions.questionMarathi: Angular reactive forms मध्ये आवश्यक field कसा validate कराल?
questions.answer: Create a FormControl with Validators.required, bind it to an input with formControl, and show feedback when the control is invalid and has been touched. This keeps validation rules in the component model.
questions.answerMarathi: Validators.required सह FormControl तयार करा, formControl ने तो input शी जोडा आणि control invalid व touched झाल्यावर सूचना दाखवा. त्यामुळे validation rules component model मध्ये राहतात.
questions.codeExplanation: The validator updates the control status, and the template displays an error after the user touches the field.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: Validator control ची स्थिती update करतो आणि वापरकर्त्याने field वापरल्यानंतर template error दाखवतो.

questions.question: How do you load data using Angular HttpClient?
questions.questionMarathi: Angular HttpClient वापरून data कसा load कराल?
questions.answer: Inject HttpClient into a service or component and call a typed method such as get<T>(). HttpClient returns an Observable; subscribe to it or bind it through the async pipe. Handle failures explicitly and provide HttpClient through the application configuration.
questions.answerMarathi: Service किंवा component मध्ये HttpClient inject करून get<T>() सारखी typed method call करा. HttpClient Observable return करतो; त्याला subscribe करा किंवा async pipe ने bind करा. Errors स्पष्टपणे हाताळा आणि application configuration मध्ये HttpClient provide करा.
questions.codeExplanation: The response is typed as User[], and the error callback handles a failed request.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: Response ला User[] type दिला आहे आणि request अयशस्वी झाल्यास error callback तो हाताळतो.

questions.question: How can you derive a value from signals without storing duplicate state?
questions.questionMarathi: Duplicate state न ठेवता signals मधून derived value कशी तयार कराल?
questions.answer: Use computed() for a read-only value derived from other signals. Angular recalculates the computed value when one of its dependencies changes, keeping the derived state consistent without manually synchronizing another variable.
questions.answerMarathi: इतर signals मधून read-only value तयार करण्यासाठी computed() वापरा. Dependency बदलल्यावर Angular computed value पुन्हा काढतो; त्यामुळे दुसरा variable हाताने synchronize न करताही derived state सुसंगत राहते.
questions.codeExplanation: total is derived from price and quantity and updates automatically when either signal changes.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: total ही price आणि quantity वरून तयार होते आणि यापैकी signal बदलल्यावर आपोआप update होते.
